title: Beware of putting your money on the table!
body: Though I cannot judge a company's service or product, I will share my less then positive experience with setting up the app. I am not stating that any of this is made by design (but I have my doubts). When you set up the app it asks for $1 for 3 days trial which is not much money, and the user leaves their credit card information. Then, once you're in, you're presented with a supporting PDF document. However, beware of clicking anywhere because there's no purchase page. Rather, the purchase is automatically completed and you're charged $27. Then, if you complain, they say they've thoroughly reviewd your purchase and you're not eligible for refund as you're request isn't compliant with their refund policy. Additionally, they take 3-4 business days to respond to your message, reassuring you all the way that they're busy, only to charge you additional $27 for a monthly subscription even though you've unsubscribed. When you complain, they answer you within 1 minute to tell you the same thing - we are not giving you YOUR money back. All of it is perfectly crafted and hidden in the plain sight under the "by continuing you agree to everything we set up in our little sheme". And just to mention, all of this happens before you have even downloaded or registered with your email for the app service. So, I resepect the work they've put into their product and service, but beware where you click and how you interact with this company because they've put some thought into convenient and easy use (read: parting you with your money before you even have a chance to see what you've signed up for).
author: User_srb95
